about: Made-up sentences of the kinds a local model wrote in graded packs (2026-11-07), each citing made-up evidence items, marked flagged or not as a careful reader would. These are the checks with no AI: wrong context through the markers, a team's work written as solo, numbers and tools the evidence lacks, and a fact with no evidence. Problems only the AI check can see (a module named as the basis of a personal project, a purpose added to fit the advert) are in ai_only, and the checks with no AI must leave them to it.
